source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Models in the unit Coteaz leads get a **6+** invulnerable save. Use **4+** against [Psychic Attacks](vsdata:core-rule/psychic).

invulnerableSave.unresolved: The text prints two different invulnerable saves, which one save block cannot hold.
